scope: Sanitized workflow aggregates; no source, raw frames, raw sessions, telemetry or live databases.
findings: Cross-row pairing is not sufficient evidence of early turning: tested 380mm corner target remains on the correct band; lookahead jumps to the exit.
Same-row unique pairs can still average into a black gap between two distinct bands.
D-only 5ms reduced synthetic command noise peak-to-peak from81.73 to36.36; P unchanged, derivative tail longer.
100ms hold exists, but one side exit is not necessarily invalid; shortening hold alone stops earlier rather than creating turn measurements.
Actual profile yaw cap250 plus nominal speed mapping corresponds to about0.501m steady tracking radius.
Prior report startup gain labels were corrected by following PID_Init assignments, not config filenames.
